column1: # Rules not listed are WARN: reported in the artifact, the run stays green
# (-I). Only FAIL rules break the run. FAIL = a header or disclosure the API
# guarantees on every response (05 §10.8), so a hit is a regression.
# IGNORE needs a reason in the note column; a real finding is fixed within
# the closing deadlines of the vulnerability policy (DOC-001).

column3: Timestamp disclosure: JSON bodies carry Unix and RFC 3339 times by design (OPS-013)
Storable/cacheable content: informational; every API response is no-store (05 §10.8) (OPS-013)
